summary_1line: Duryodhana poisons and drowns Bhima, but snake venom revives him in the Naga realm where he drinks nectar granting immense strength.

image_candidates.scene_text: Duryodhana secretly binds the unconscious Bhima with forest vines and pushes his heavy body into a dark river at dusk.
In the underwater Naga realm, thousands of serpents coil around Bhima and strike him with glowing fangs.
Bhima sits among jeweled serpent kings and lifts a massive jar of nectar, drinking it in one breath while serpents watch.
